chapter: Royal Roost, Birdland and Three O'Clock High
title: Elliot Lawrence's band opposite them
summary: Elliot Lawrence's band with Gerry Mulligan and a Eckstine-style white singer played opposite them at Bop City.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Jerry Mulligan was in the band. Oh, they had -- Elliot Lawrence had a tremendous band, and they had a singer there, Bill -- who was singing like a white singer, what was his name? He sang like Billy Eckstine.
A white singer song like Billy Eckstine?

Yeah, well I'll think of his name anyway. He came out here quite often. Now as a matter of fact he just recorded again, very good singer, very good singer. But any way, during that time it was the Royal Roost and Bop City. I think Birdland -- I'm sure Birdland came a little later.
